svg.title: Bench wiring: four BANDC momentary rockers to the Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO
svg.desc: Each rocker common goes to the board DGND terminal; the throw that closes on UP goes to the odd digital input and the DOWN throw to the even input. The COM terminal stays empty. The board is powered from a current-limited bench 12 V supply on the 7-36 V block; relay terminals carry no load during bench tests.
svg.text: Bench wiring: BANDC momentary rockers to Waveshare ESP32-S3-POE-ETH-8DI-8RO
Dry-contact inputs only. No trailer load, no 12 V on any DI/DGND/COM terminal. Terminal legends from Waveshare images; confirm on the received board.
ANT: SMA antenna fitted. USB-C: first flash only, unplugged while on DC. ETH/PoE, RS485: unused.
NO / COM / NC: find with meter

Bench: no load on any relay terminal.
Switch ON in HA = NO closed.
chain commons with piggyback spades or a

Suggested 22/4 cable colours (one run per rocker)
Colours are a convention only; the meter result decides which pin is which.
The common is the pin that connects to one neighbour on UP
and to the other on DOWN; centre = open to both.
